model_engine_config.thinking_control_source: google/gemma-4-31B-it chat_template.jinja (Hugging Face, main branch): 'enable_thinking' is set(enable_thinking | default(false)) and, when explicitly false, suppresses the '<|think|>' insertion at the system turn. Together's Chat Completions API documents chat_template_kwargs as an object passed through to the model engine (confirmed against the installed together-python 2.31.0 SDK type definitions). Together's google/gemma-4-31B-it serverless model page documents the model as supporting configurable thinking mode. Provider-side pass-through of chat_template_kwargs specifically for the Together Batch API endpoint has not been empirically confirmed; the one-request engineering capability preflight in outputs/together_smoke/tiny_pre_api verifies this before the 12-request first-wave smoke is ever submitted.
